description: Read a generation brief from rawPrompt. Source-video edits return execution for generation_video_create with required assets and transformation controls. New scenes return an authoring grammar and planJsonSchema for generation_plan_validate. This read does not generate media or spend credits.

genre.description: Genre pack id (e.g. pixar-culture-skit). The brief lists available ids in availableGenres; the pack's beats and visual contract override the generic grammar.

rawPrompt.description: Original request. Clone or character-replacement requests select a video transformation brief instead of a new-story plan.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Desired final video duration in seconds.

videoModelId.description: Target video model id (see generation_options_list, kind: video). Defaults to the strongest single-take model.

visualStyle.description: Visual style preset id; its locked style contract is included in the brief.

name: generation_plan_brief

execution.description: Source-video operation, model and required assets; null for new-story plans.

title: Get Generation Plan Brief
